content:
Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. stands as a prominent chemical technology enterprise strategically located in the Minhang District of Shanghai, China. Since its establishment, the company has evolved into a trusted leader in the chemical industry, specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality chemical reagents, laboratory chemicals, and specialty chemical products.

Operating from Shanghai's dynamic Minhang District, a hub for technological innovation and industrial development, Meryer benefits from excellent infrastructure and proximity to major research institutions and universities. This strategic location enables the company to maintain strong connections with the scientific community while efficiently serving customers throughout China and internationally.

Meryer's comprehensive product portfolio encompasses over 30,000 chemical products, including analytical reagents, biochemicals, organic and inorganic compounds, solvents, and customized chemical solutions. The company serves diverse sectors including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, academic research institutions, environmental testing laboratories, and various industrial applications.

Committed to quality and innovation, Meryer maintains state-of-the-art facilities equipped with advanced analytical instruments and follows stringent quality control protocols. The company adheres to international standards and holds relevant certifications, ensuring product reliability and consistency. With a team of experienced chemists and technical professionals, Meryer continues to expand its capabilities, focusing on sustainable practices and contributing to the advancement of chemical science and technology in China and beyond.
